title_en: At Siri Kodra, a spacious 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for living!!!
description_en: At Siri Kodra, 1+1 apartment for sale with ample spaces, ideal for living. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in the entrance corridor that divides into the living room together with the cooking and dining area with access to the balcony, a bedroom with access to the balcony, and a spacious bathroom. The orientation of the apartment is west. The area in which the apartment is located offers a variety of facilities for a more comfortable life. It is also a very good option for investment considering the rents in the area. The property has full mortgage documentation.
